The main takeaway from our work is that

the concept of displacement-current wires is not limited to the near-zero permittivty media, but can be extended to other metastructures with a strong contrast between effective permittivity of the wire and that of the surrounding medium.
the effective permittivity can be used to control the propagation of displacement currents in a manner analogous to the control of conduction currents in metallic wires and cables.
